summary: A per-visit counter rises forever and bleaches into its own ground, then resets to 1 on reload — digital infinity as free, amnesiac, the inverse of a life's labour.
mechanism: requestAnimationFrame increments an integer while a tint function interpolates its colour toward the page background as a function of the same count; no persistence, no network, reload restarts at 1.
references: On Kawara, I Am Still Alive
